ns2:section.sectionText: Connecting Work Experience and Your Education. This course connects a work/internship experience with your education in a directed manner that will help develop your personal, educational, and professional competencies. Students must secure an approved work/intern experience for the summer (minimum of 8 hours of work per week for at least 6-8 weeks) by May 16. If section is full, please contact Gail Rooney (grooney@illinois.edu) and include full name and UIN. Students are required to be online 6:00-8:30 pm on May 14, 16 & 21, June 11 & 18, July 2, 16 & 30.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Liberal Arts & Sciences or Division of General Studies. Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
